div.head: IV Eg 1.5
div.ab: Þonne beode ic minum gerefan, be minum freondscipe ⁊ be eallum þam þe hy ágon, þæt hy styran ælcum þara þe þis ne gelæste ⁊ minra witena wed abrecan mid ænegum wacscipe wille, swa swa him seo foresæde geradnes tæce; ⁊ on þære steore ne sy nan forgifnes.

Ðonne beode ic minum gerefan, be minum freondscype ⁊ be eallum þam ðe hi ágon, þæt hi styran ælcum þara ðe þis ne gelæste ⁊ minra witena wed abrecan mid ænegum wacscype wille, swa swa him seo foresæde geradnes tæce; ⁊ on ðære steore ne sy nan forgyfnes.

Preterea prepositi nostri ac magnati omnes seua districtione coercere studeant qui pactum stabilitum uiolare satagunt et istud adimplere recusant, sicuti prelibatę locutionis ordinatio illis demonstrat; nec ulla miseratio pro tanta preuaricatione fiat.

Ðonne beode ic minum gerefan, be minum freondscype ⁊ be eallum þam ðe hi ágon, þæt hi styran ælcum þara ðe þis ne gelæste ⁊ minra witena wed abrecan mid ænegum wacscype wille, swa swa him seo foresæde geradnes tæce; ⁊ on ðære steore ne sy nan forgyfnes.

Further, I enjoin upon my reeves, on pain of forfeiting my friendship and all they possess, to deal in the manner prescribed by the aforesaid ordinance with everyone who fails to perform this, and by any remissness on his part, consents to violate the solemn declaration of my councillors. And there shall be no remission of the [prescribed] punishment.

Moreover, I command my reeves, on pain of losing my friendship and all that they own, that they punish each of those who does not perform this and who wishes to break the pledge of my councillors by any remissness, just as the aforesaid ordinance directs them; and there is to be no remission of that punishment.

Ferner gebiet ich meinen Vögten, bei [Verlust] meiner Freundschaft und alles dessen, was sie besitzen, dass sie jeden derer, welcher dies nicht leistet und das rechtsförmliche Versprechen meiner Witan durch irgend welche Lässigkeit brechen will, so bestrafen, wie ihnen die vorgenannte Verordnung vorschreibt; und in dieser Strafe gebe es keine Erlassung.

Further I command my reeves, on [pain of losing] my friendship and all that they own, that they punish everyone who does not pay this and wishes to break my witan's pledge through any slackness, as the aforesaid ordinance prescribes for them; and let there be no remission in this punishment.
